answer.thought: The hazy light filters through the sheer curtains, turning the room into a suspended gray. I have sat long enough with the silence of the empty kitchen and the weight of the unpaid wages. To think clearly about the state and the individual, one must first attend to the body’s refusal to function without fuel. I shall rest my eyes until the heat breaks.
